name: Nagybudmér (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nagybudmér: a crowned shield of blue and red with a wing and a plough, with yellow and red mantling and a scroll inscribed NAGYBUDMÉR.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nagybudmér arms with crown, mantling and scroll
